scope: Causality,execution and cost-accounting preflight of an existing public supply/demand strategy,including ONE reused real-price month replay. Not a corrected strategy or profitability certification.

source_contract.rules: Impulse body>=1.5ATR,body/range>=.55;base<=6candles;zone width<=1.2%;trend/BOS/volume/liquidity strength;zone-edge entry;stop beyond opposite edge1ATR;dynamic opposite-zone/liquidity target or2.5R;min1.5R;cluster0.8%;max4positions using source OPTIMAL_PARAMS fixed before replay.
source_contract.source_costs: Maker0.02% entry/TP,taker0.05% and additive0.05%SL slippage;entry rejected if estimated costs>0.3R;no explicit funding in engine. Source risk1%of modeled balance is only reproduced inside diagnostic simulation,not adopted operationally.
source_contract.claim: Author CLAUDE.md lists approximately27300trades,+14760R,PF2.11 for8coins;no numerical BTC-only ledger/cache in repository tree. Treat as unverified source claim.
source_contract.execution: Hash-guarded constant expressions and inspected pure function definitions only;skip imports,config mkdir,startup,main,cache download,live/,pickle,credentials and orders. No dependency installation.

fixed_probes: Future-only liquidity target level with last_idx later than the trade; compare fixed fallback target.
Only a future candle sweeps a known level; compare past zone swept flag with unchanged historical prefix.
Centered swing near prefix end requires5later candles; inspect source confirmation timing.
Full detect_zones(no_lookahead=True)+backtest on fixed31bar impulse fixture;record formation,entry and exit bar.
Previously known demand zone,gap beyond stop;compare source exit with complete bar price range.
Previously known limit zone,same OHLC except final close;test whether closing freshness suppresses an earlier stop-out.
SL/TP both touched:positive control for source stop-first handling.
No SL/TP before data end:retain source open status as unknown,not a zero-return completed trade.
Reconcile source price-fee calculation and identical-fill double-fee arithmetic on fixed control fixtures only;do not call this a market cost-stress pass.

real_price_replay.data_kind: Previously observed exploratory Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual prices;not original Kraken replication,independent sample or native LBank fills.
real_price_replay.integrity: Exact ascending minute grid,OHLC/volume/close-time checks,30complete minutes per30m bar;no missing data/interpolation/artificial gap exits. Existing Git source catalog includes original official manifest/SHA and no January2024 quarantine.
real_price_replay.experiment: Run unchanged source functions on first20days versus full31days,source OPTIMAL_PARAMS and no_lookahead=True,passing source full liquidity list exactly as original run_test. Compare historical zone attributes,entry plans and only outcomes fully inside common prefix;do not treat newly resolved past-open trades as a causality failure. Count same-formation-bar entries/exits. No optimization/parameter repair or choice of another month based on results.
real_price_replay.outputs: Raw provenance,compressed30m input,complete two-run zone/trade/equity diagnostics,changed historical records,small-case probes and actual result report.

decision_rule: An active future-dependence or impossible timing/fill failure rejects THIS source version as replacement evidence. Preserve numerical findings even if unexpected;do not tune to save original headline. Source-family profitability not universally invalidated.
promotion_gates: Net expectancy95%lower,netPF,2xcost,TP1Wilson,5m native urgent events,manual fill latency,DDinR and30day/100closed forward remain unverified until a separate complete causal contract is frozen and actually evaluated.
